review_notes: I read the whole target file and its neighbours in StructureConstant: Symmetry.lean (cyclic symmetry, `structureConstant_neg_neg_of_hom`), Basic.lean (skew), and Normalization.lean. Normalization.lean is the only other place that repeats the core step. It does so in `structureConstant_neg_add_mul_killingForm_eq`, which uses the same cyclic and skew inputs on the same triple (γ, -α, β) with the same auxiliary root-sum proofs. I did not compile anything, so the proposed helper name and exact signature are untested. I treated the closing algebra (cancelling the Killing pairing at γ, and the top·(p+1) ratio calculation) as too short to flag. I found no other repeated machinery in the file. The second theorem's proof is short and has no counterpart elsewhere.

findings.problem: The proof applies the cyclic Killing-form symmetry to the triple (γ, -α, β) and then skew-symmetry. This gives the Chevalley-free identity N(-α,-β)·B(xγ,x(-γ)) = -N(-α,γ)·B(xβ,x(-β)). Normalization.lean (`structureConstant_neg_add_mul_killingForm_eq`) repeats the same step. It builds the same two root-sum equations (`hγα` and `hαγ`/`hβγ`, each proved by `rw [Weight.coe_neg, hαβ]; abel`). It calls `structureConstant_mul_killingForm_eq γ (-α) β hβ hγα hγ` and `structureConstant_skew (-α) γ β hβ _`. It then rewrites with both, and only afterwards uses `structureConstant_neg_neg_of_hom` to turn N(-α,-β) into -N(α,β). Both files re-derive the same intermediate fact, along with the `Weight.coe_neg`/`abel` side conditions. The calc in the target also repeats this relation inline, in the steps `rw [hcyc]` and `rw [hskew]`.
findings.proposed_change: Add one lemma in Symmetry.lean, which both files already import. It takes the same hypotheses as the target: hx, hβ, hγ and hαβ. It states `hx.structureConstant (-α) (-β) (-γ) hγ.neg _ * killingForm K L (x γ) (x (-γ)) = -(hx.structureConstant (-α) γ β hβ _ * killingForm K L (x β) (x (-β)))`. The root-sum equations are proved once, inside it. The target's calc then starts from this lemma, so `hcyc`, `hskew`, `hβγ` and `hγα` disappear and the two `rw` steps collapse into one. In Normalization.lean, `structureConstant_neg_add_mul_killingForm_eq` becomes: rewrite the helper with `hneg` and finish with `neg_mul`/`neg_inj`.
findings.benefit: The cyclic-then-skew derivation and its root-sum bookkeeping live in one place. Both consumers drop their copies of the setup. The Chevalley-free relation is stated explicitly, which makes it clear what Normalization.lean adds (only `hneg`) and what the target adds (only the root-length ratio).
